Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The number of appeared candidates and passed candidates (in hundreds) in a test from five different institutions.

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Candidates passed from institute C = 8

Candidates passed from institute D = 26

Candidates appeared from institute B = 24

Candidates appeared from institute E = 20

**Formula used:**

Percentage = frac{{candidate passed}}{{candidate appeared}}×100 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total candidate appeared in institution B and E = 24 + 20 = 44

According to the formula,

⇒ Percentage = frac{{34}}{{44}}×100 = 77%

**⇒ ****Hence, The percentage is 77%**

questions.question: Two trains are moving in the opposite direction at the speed of 48 km/hr and 60 km/hr respectively. The time taken by the slower train to cross a man sitting in the faster train is 12 seconds. What is the length of the slower train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed in opposite directions = 48 + 60 = 108 km/hr.

Convert relative speed to m/s = 108 × (5/18) = 30 m/s.

Length of the slower train = Relative Speed × Time taken.

Length = 30 × 12 = 360 metres.

**∴ The correct answer is 360 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

• 
 48 km/hr

 60 km/hr

 
 Man

 
 Relative Speed = 108 km/hr

**Given:**

Speed of slower train (S₁) = 48 km/hr

Speed of faster train (S₂) = 60 km/hr

Time taken to cross the man (T) = 12 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

Distance = Speed × Time

Conversion: 1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 48 + 60 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 108 × (5/18) = 30 m/s

⇒ The man sitting in the faster train represents a point object moving at 60 km/hr in the opposite direction.

⇒ The distance covered to cross the man is exactly equal to the length of the slower train.

⇒ Length of slower train = 30 m/s × 12 s

⇒ Length of slower train = 360 metres

**∴ The correct answer is 360 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing a Point Object

When a train crosses a pole, tree, or a standing/moving man, the total distance covered is equal to the length of the crossing train itself.

Speed Conversion Rule

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

questions.question: A shopkeeper listed the marked price of a chair at a certain amount. If the shopkeeper declares a 15% discount and sold it at Rs. 1,445, then what is the marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Shopkeeper declares a discount of 15%

Selling price = Rs. 1445

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 - Discount)%

**Calculations:**

According to the formula,

⇒ SP = MP × (100 - 15)%

⇒ 1445 = MP × 85%

⇒ MP = (1445)/(85)×100 = 1700

**⇒ Hence, The marked price of the chair is Rs. 1700**

questions.question: A person having bought goods for Rs. 400 sells half of it at a gain of 5%. At what gain percentage must he sell the remainder, so as to gain 25% on the whole?
questions.solution:
Given:

A person having bought goods for Rs. 400 sells half of it at a gain of 5%

He has to gain 25% on the whole

Formula used:

Percentage = (Profit)/(CP)×100

Calculations:

As he sell half of it at a gain of 5%

Rs. 200 at a profit of 5%

⇒ SP = 200 + 5% of 200 = 200 + 10 = Rs. 210

Now he has to gain 25% on the whole

⇒ Gain = 400 + 25% of 400 = 400 + 100 = Rs. 500

⇒ Profit he has to earned more = 500 - 210 = Rs. 290

⇒ Profit = 290 - 200 = 90

According to the formula,

⇒ Percentage = (90)/(200)×100= 45%

**⇒ Hence, He has to sell the remaining part at 45%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

1st ​Half of 400 = 200, sells at 5% profit, CP = 200 SP = 210

Final profit on 400, 25% so CP = 400 and SP = 500

So, the 2ⁿd half CP = 200 and SP = (500 - 210) = 290

Profit% = 90/200 × 100 = 45%

questions.question: If cot A = {12 over5}, then the value of sin A = ?
questions.solution:
Given:

cot A = {12 over5}

Formula used:

(Hypotenuse)² = (Perpendicular)² + (Height)²

Calculations:

⇒ cot A ={Baseover Perpendicular}= {12 over5}

⇒ Length of the perpendicular = 5

⇒ Lenth of the base = 12

Using the above formula,

⇒ (Hypotenuse)2 = (Perpendicular)2 + (Height)²

⇒ (Hypotenuse)2 = 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169

⇒ Hypotenuse = sqrt{169} = 13

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4a45d64b3973c140f84cd8ede09b0d0de5843aabf8a1578aa22128ccf37370d.png] 

⇒ Sin A = (Perpendicular)/(Hypotenuse )={5over13}

**⇒ Hence, Value of sin A is 5/13**

questions.question: If x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}} then the value of x² - xy + y² over x² +xy + y² = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}}

**Calculations:**

According to question,

 x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} 

⇒x = 9 - 4√5

⇒x² = 161 - 72√5

and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}} 

⇒y = 9 + 4√5

⇒y² = 161 + 72√5

Now, 

 x² - xy + y² over x² +xy + y²

= (161 - 72√5 - 1 + 161 + 72√5)/(161 - 72√5 + 1 + 161 + 72√5)

= (322 - 1)/(322 + 1)

= 321/323

**Hence, The Required value is 321/323.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

We know, if x = ((p - q))/((p + q)) and y = ((p + q))/((p - q)) then (x + y) = (2times (p² + q²))/((p² - q²))

 x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}} so, x + y = (2(sqrt5² + sqrt4²))/((5 - 4)) = 18 and xy = 1

So, x² - xy + y² over x² +xy + y² = ((x + y)² - 3xy)/((x + y)² -xy) = (18² - 3)/(18² -1) = 321/323

questions.question: In a division sum, the divisor is 10 times the quotient and four times the remainder. What is the dividend if the remainder is 45?
questions.solution:
Given:

In a division sum, the divisor is 10 times the quotient and 4 times the remainder. If the remainder is 45.

Concept used:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

The divisor is four times the remainder

Remainder = 45

Divisor = 45 × 4

The Divisor is Ten times the Quotient 

⇒ 45 × 4 = 10 × Q

⇒ Q = (45 × 4) / 10

⇒ Q = 18

Now using the Basic Formulae

Dividend = 45 × 4 × 18 + 45

Dividend = 3285

**Hence, The Required value is 3285.**

questions.question: A and B invested their money in a business in the ratio of 9 ∶ 5. If 10% of the total profit goes for charity and A’s share is Rs. 29,840, what is the total profit (in Rs., to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total distributed profit = Total profit × 90%.

A's share = Total profit × (90 / 100) × [9 / (9 + 5)].

29840 = Total profit × (9 / 10) × (9 / 14).

Total profit = 29840 × (140 / 81) = 4177600 / 81 = 51575.30...

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 51,575.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment ratio of A and B = 9 : 5

Percentage of profit going to charity = 10%

A's profit share = Rs. 29,840

**Formula Used:**

Profit ratio = Investment ratio (when the time period is identical)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aa64d11c2782894d903762947d6faf235f5bfb4ca30f205a9848154f511a62b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total profit be P.

⇒ Profit distributed between A and B = P − 10% of P = 90% of P = 0.9P.

⇒ Investment ratio of A and B = 9 : 5

⇒ Total ratio parts = 9 + 5 = 14 parts.

⇒ A's profit share = (9 / 14) of the remaining profit

⇒ 29840 = (9 / 14) × 0.9P

⇒ 29840 = (8.1 / 14) × P

⇒ P = (29840 × 14) / 8.1

⇒ P = 417760 / 8.1 = 4177600 / 81

⇒ P = 51575.308...

⇒ Rounding to the nearest integer, Total Profit ≈ Rs. 51,575

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 51,575.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sleeping Partner

A partner who only invests money but does not take part in the management of the business is known as a sleeping partner. Active partners receive a fixed salary or a certain percentage of the profit for managing the business before the remaining profit is distributed among all partners.

Compound Partnership

When investments are made for different time periods, it is called a compound partnership. The profit share ratio is the product of capital invested and the time period of investment (P₁ : P₂ = C₁×T₁ : C₂×T₂).

Joining Mid-way

If a partner joins x months after the start of a financial year, their investment time period for that year is (12 − x) months, which must be multiplied by their capital to determine their final profit share ratio compared to the primary investors.
